title: QVEX — Quantum Vacuum Exchange Engine
description:
QVEX (Quantum Vacuum Exchange Engine) is a modular, DAG-based research scaffold for coupled optical/photonic cavity simulations, dynamic inter-cavity coupling, boundary stress integration, and geometric curvature proxies.

It provides a deterministic pure-Python graph execution engine, 20 physics node modules exposing 14 registered node types, JSON-defined pipelines validated against a JSON schema, and a 64-test pytest suite with CI on Python 3.10-3.12.

Highlights: photonic cavity resonators and non-Markovian cavities, Berry-curvature and geometric-torque bridges, tetrahedral angular-deficit curvature, popcorn-vacuum nucleation modulation, and observational coupling against the SPARC rotation-curve dataset. Every node and document carries an explicit epistemic class (Class A established experiments through Class D frontier predictions).

Scope: preliminary/schematic research scaffold - physical mappings are phenomenological and require observational fitting before any scientific claim.
